描述

这是一个简单的 Qwen 图像分层工作流程。
这个模型才发布了几个小时，所以还没有进行大量优化，因此我只发布这个工作流程，因为目前在 civita 或其他地方没有发布其他工作流程。

如果您想了解有关此型号的更多信息，可以查看官方 Huggingface 存储库，但它基本上所做的是将您的图像转换为多个图层，以便在 Photoshop 等软件中进一步编辑，甚至可以自己使用。
通过这种方式，您可以从背景中删除角色和/或对象，并一次编辑或组合它们一层。

目前此工作流程仅支持将图像分成图层 - 这不是集成 Qwen-Image-Edit 来编辑所选图层的一体化解决方案。
该工作流程只是作为一个简单易用的工具来测试新模型并使用它来分离图像层，并且其功能相对简单。

工作流程和模型都没有真正针对低显存进行优化，我只能说它在 24GB 显存上运行良好，并且可以在约 200 秒内以 1024 像素的分辨率将图像分成 3 层。

谢谢你！

感谢您使用此工作流程，如果您最终用它创建了一些东西，我会很高兴看到您的结果发布在模型页面上！
如果您有任何疑问或问题，请随时在此模型页面的评论部分中提出 -但如果您遇到问题，请记住附上您的错误日志.

一旦我自己更多地使用它，我可能会更新工作流程，因为我计划使用它来生成 Live2D 动画。
但没有承诺！

Description

This is a simple Qwen Image Layered workflow.
This model has only been out for a few hours so it's not heavily optimized yet, therefore i am only releasing this workflow since there are no other workflows currently released on civitai or elsewhere.

If you want to find out more about this model you can check out theofficial huggingface repository, but what it basically does is that it turns your image into multiple layers for further editing in software like photoshop or even comfy itself.
This way you can remove a character and/or objects from the background and edit or compose them one layer at a time.

This Workflow currentlyONLYsupports seperating the image into layers - this is not an All-in-One Solution with Qwen-Image-Edit integrated to also edit the selected layers.
This Workflow is only meant as a simple and easy tool to test out the new model and use it to seperate image layers and is relatively barebones in it's functionality.

Neither the workflow nor the model are really optimized for low vram, all i can say is that it works well on 24GB of VRAM and can seperate an image into 3 layers in ~200 seconds at a resolution of 1024px.

Thank you!

Thank you for using this workflow and if you end up creating something with it i'd be excited to see your results posted here on the model page!
If you have any questions or problems feel free to ask them in the comment section here on this model page -but if you're having issues please remember to attach your error log.

I will probably update the workflow once i have played around with it more myself since i'm planning to use this for Live2D animation generation.
No promises though!
